name: Komodo dragon
desc: The largest lizard. Adults ambush deer, pigs and buffalo and also eat carrion; young eat insects, birds, eggs and small reptiles.
about: The Komodo dragon, also known as the Komodo monitor, is a large reptile of the monitor lizard family Varanidae that is endemic to the Indonesian islands of Komodo, Rinca, Flores, Gili Dasami, and…
